$comment: TRAJYX canonical domain contract. Single source of truth for enums and thresholds shared by backend (Python), web (TypeScript) and mobile (Dart). Regenerate language bindings with: python scripts/gen_contracts.py

Role.doc: Authorization roles. Ordered from most to least privileged.

RiskLevel.doc: Coarse risk band derived from a 0-100 risk score.

Severity.doc: Event severity, independent of the numeric risk score.

EventType.doc: Canonical event taxonomy emitted by the safety, interaction and risk engines.

EventCategory.doc: Grouping used by dashboard navigation and reporting.

VehicleClass.doc: Detector output classes. Extend by adding here and retraining/remapping the detector.

CameraStatus.doc: Operational state of a camera as shown in Live Monitoring.

JobStatus.doc: Lifecycle of an asynchronous video analysis job.

TtcBand.doc: Band for an ESTIMATED time-to-collision value. Always presented as an estimate.

Determination.doc: Tri-state result for any visual check. UNABLE_TO_DETERMINE is a first-class outcome and must never be collapsed into a negative.

DataOrigin.doc: Provenance label. Every record carries one so simulated and estimated values are never displayed as measured ground truth.

HazardType.doc: Hazard categories a driver can report from the mobile app.

ReportStatus.doc: Review workflow state for driver hazard reports and flagged violations.

ModelHealth.doc: Operational health of a registered model version.

SignalState.doc: Traffic signal phase used by the red-light violation detector. UNKNOWN suppresses red-light detection entirely.

alert_thresholds.$comment: Defaults only. Runtime values are read from the settings collection so operators can tune them per deployment.
